requirements.quote: Add per-workspace API keys (hashed at rest, shown once), scopes, per-key quotas and rate limits
a usage key for billed calls via the #30 usage service
and a BearerResolver (apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts) that resolves keys to a principal.
Register in cross-tenant, core-domains and db test lists.
Acceptance: keys, scopes and quotas are enforced and usage is billed per call [integration].

deliverables.change: New workspace-scoped `api_key` table (hash only, prefix, scopes, monthly quota, per-minute rate limit, expiry, revoked_at, created_by) with tenant RLS; export from schema/index.ts
Export the api-keys schema
Create api_key table, RLS policies and owner-defined SECURITY DEFINER lookup `app_api_key_by_hash(text)`; regenerate meta snapshot and journal (renumber if base took 0080)

New domain: createApiKey (plaintext returned once, sha256 stored), listApiKeys, revokeApiKey (audited, owner/admin), authenticateApiKey (hash lookup, expiry/revoked checks, constant-time), scope vocabulary, consumeApiCall (monthly quota check + increment('api.calls') idempotent per request)
Add counter key 'api.calls' to USAGE_KEYS and USAGE_KEY_KINDS
Add ./api-keys subpath export mirroring ./usage
Re-export the api-keys domain if other domains are re-exported there
Add createApiKeyResolver(db): BearerResolver mapping a valid key to a Principal carrying apiKey {id, workspaceId, scopes, limits}
Extend Principal with optional apiKey; add requireScope(scope) route middleware (403 FORBIDDEN on missing scope)
New middleware: reject header/path workspace differing from key workspace, per-key rate limit (429 RATE_LIMITED), quota exhaustion (429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED), bill one api.calls per request
Key counters by api key id when the principal carries one, using the key's per-minute limit
Default bearer resolver to the API-key resolver; wire the api-key middleware
Add 'api-keys' domain dependencies (audit, usage, workspaces)
Document the api-keys domain and its dependencies
Register api-keys exports in SERVICE_TESTS (or NOT_A_SERVICE with reason) and the api_key table
Real cases: B cannot list or revoke A's keys; A's keys unchanged
Add api_key to the root table list
Add api_key to the RLS catalog (and TABLE_TESTS/seeders if the guard requires)
Integration tests: shown once and hashed at rest, revoked/expired rejected, scopes, quota exhaustion, one api.calls per call, idempotent on request id
End-to-end through createApp: valid key 200, bad key 401, missing scope 403, per-key rate limit 429, quota 429 and usage counter incremented

CI fix: apiKeyCallsThisPeriod (:289) passes a Date into a raw sql`` template (ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE, also the 500s in apps/api api-keys tests); use drizzle gte(usageEvent.createdAt, usagePeriod(at).start) instead
CI fix: export api_key via ws('api_key',{exclude:['token_hash'],userColumn:'created_by'}) in the exporter that holds workspace_integration (:173); secrets never leave
CI fix: add 'api_key' to PURGE_ORDER (purge-coverage test), next to workspace_integration

preserve.what: Cookie-session auth and `GET /v1/me` behaviour; Principal.apiKey is optional (apps/api/src/__tests__/auth.test.ts, authorize.test.ts)
Existing usage keys, meter idempotency and `increment` signature (packages/core/src/usage/meter.ts, usage tests)
Default per-user/IP rate limit behaviour and headers (apps/api/src/__tests__/rate-limit.test.ts)
requireWorkspace membership check semantics (apps/api/src/middleware/workspace.ts); cross-tenant route list in apps/api/src/__tests__/cross-tenant.test.ts

decisions.choice: Principal for an API key carries `user` = the key's creator plus an optional `apiKey` field, so requireWorkspace and authorize keep working unchanged
decisions.justification: apps/api/src/lib/openapi.ts:12-16 requires a SessionUser and middleware/workspace.ts:50 checks membership; a removed creator then invalidates the key

decisions.choice: Key lookup by hash through an owner-defined SECURITY DEFINER function
decisions.justification: api_key is tenant FORCE RLS and the workspace is unknown before authentication; same pattern as app_cause_list_watch_targets in migrations/0068_cause_list_watch.sql

decisions.choice: sha256 + random secret, token shown once
decisions.justification: packages/core/src/workspaces/invitations.ts:4,40-41 hashes high-entropy tokens this way; slow hashes are unnecessary for 256-bit secrets

decisions.choice: New core domain 'api-keys' depending on audit, usage, workspaces only
decisions.justification: core-domains.js:55 map and docs/engineering/core-domains.md require declared domain deps through index.ts
